notes.title: Street Robbery Update
notes.notes:
[h1]New Street Robbery[/h1]
[h3][list]
[*] Aim at a player with a weapon to start robbery
[*] Players cant enter MOAs or POAs while being robbed
[*] Gang members can no longer instantly take damage unless being robbed
[/list][/h3]

notes.notes:
[h1]Added Street PvP[/h1]

[*] When you shoot a person and they shoot back at you, combat will start between you and the player you shot at.
